items.summary: The following is a summary of major ship movements and exercises in the Western Pacific over the last week.  In Singapore The Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group pulled into Singapore on Friday for a port visit. The strike group includes aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) with embarked carrier air wing (CVW) 11, cruiser USS Chosin (CG-65) and destroyers USS Paul Hamilton (DDG-60) and USS Decatur (DDG-73). Theodore Roosevelt, Chosin and Paul Hamilton docked into Changi Naval Base while Decatur docked into Sembawang. items.name: Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group Pulls Into Singapore
items.summary: The Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group pulled into Singapore on Friday for a port visit, USNI News understands.  The TR CSG, which includes aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) with embarked carrier air wing (CVW) 11, cruiser USS Chosin (CG-65) and destroyers USS Paul Hamilton (DDG-60) and USS Decatur (DDG-73), is expected to head to the Middle East following its port visit.  Ship spotters saw USS Decatur (DDG-73) coming into Singapore on Friday.  Singapore, lies on the Malacca Strait, which connects the South China Sea to the Indian Ocean.
